3. It is the case of the plaintiff that .011/4 acres of land of plot No.1409 appertaining to C.S. khatian No.742 corresponding to S.A. khatian No.1203 of Mouza No.137, Bhagaban Nagar within Police Station Sailakupa Jhenaidah was recorded in the name of Rehan Uddin Mandal in Khatian No.1203 Rehan Uddin Mandal died leaving sons and wife, defendant Nos.1-5. There is a path way on the land of plot No.1406 which the plaintiffs using for coming and going; there is another path way in plot No.2915 but plot No.1407 and 1410 are contiguous to Suit Plot No.1409 and road of plot No.1410 and 1407 is linked by the road of plot No.2915. Plaintiffs have used the said road for 33 years. Plaintiff No.1 along with the members of her family resides in some portion of land south to plot No.1410 and in whole part of plot No.1407 for 33 years by erecting homestead therein. 

 5. Defendant's cases are that Al acres of land of suit plot No.1409 appertaining to S.A khatian No.959 of Mouza No.137, Bhagaban Nagar belonged to Rehannuddin Mondal. Rehannuddin Mondal alienated .41 acres of land of plot No.1409 to defendant Nos.3 and 4 by registered kobla dated 17.9.1987, 2.2.1987 and to defendant No.5 by registered kobla dated 29.7.1987. R.S. record has been prepared in their names correctly. Defendants have homestead and different kinds of fruit bearing trees. There is a road in a portion of the suit plot, the non -suited plot Nos.1407-1408 is contiguous west to the suit plot No.1409. The land of plot No.I407 is contiguous north to non -suited plot No.1408 and the land of plot No.1410 is contiguous north to plot No.1407. The land of plot No.141 i is contiguous east to plot No 1410 and the land of plot No.1416 and 1417 is contiguous north to plot No.1411. There was no house of plaintiff No.1 in the land of plot Nos.1407 and 1410. Plaintiff No.1 acquired a bit title in the land of plot No.1410 and 1407 but with a view to grab some portion of the land of the road of plot No.1406 she commenced erecting house on the month of Falgun, 1408 B.S to the eastern side of plot No.1410 and 1407 and erected one kitchen, one tin shed house having two rooms, one latrine and one tube well in the land of road of plot No.1406. There was no road in the land of plot No.1409 and at present no road has gone through the suit plot. 

 7. Appellate Court reversed the findings on consideration of exhibits 1 series, 2, by and Kha, all these documents filed 133 the plaintiffs and defendants and in' C.S. and S.A. Khatian, there is mentioned of a road and defendant No.4 also admitted there is a road and plaintiffs has no other road. On consideration of this fact, learned District Judge, Jhinaidaha reversed the findings of the trial Court. 

 8. I have already mentioned that learned Advocate for the petitioners did not appear in Court at any time. Mr. S. N. Goswami learned Advocate appearing for the opposite parties submits that trial Court without discussing the exhibits on record held that there is homestead on the road and in getting a decree for easement right plaintiffs ought to pray for removing of those construction, which is wrong finding. Learned Advocate further submits on reference to the judgment that plaintiffs in their dispositions stated that they have used the road for the last 33 years which the defendants did not denied. Learned Advocate further submits that learned Judge on reference to the khatian and exhibits filed by both the parties found that there is a road mentioned in the khatian and these finding with . reference to the exhibits on record is binding upon this Court in its revisional jurisdiction. 

 9. I have considered the submissions of the learned Advocate for the opposite parties and judgments of the Courts below and exhibits. It appears that trial Court without discussing any exhibits filed by the parties, only on oral evidence of PW2 held that there are construction on the pathway. Learned Judge of the Appellate Court found that P.W.1 to PW.4 have clearly stated in their evidences that there was a road on the land of the suit plot which have been used by the plaintiffs for 33 years. P.W.1 to P.W.4 have given their corroborative testimonies in respect of the path way on the suit plot but no suggestion was suggested to these witnesses to the effect that there was no road on the suit plot. I also find from the exhibits filed by the parties i.e. khatians that there is a road on the suit plot as such I hold learned Judge of Appellate Court committed no illegality in allowing the appeal and decreeing the suit.
